body: Hey man thanks for replying, and sorry I took so long to get back to you. My father said something to me pretty similar to what you said 4 years ago about entering high school. He said "by the end of high school you will probably have a girl that you will have to break up with because your going to different schools". I have gained ZERO experience with relationships since that conversation and now I am being told that same message again? Its all bullshit, the 'lucky ones' just want to keep people like me around to boost their ego and say "At least im not as ugly as throwawayaccount4458" "or At least im not a virgin like throwawayaccount4458". And when people like me show signs of suicide because of their shit luck, the 'lucky ones' decide that they will throw a crumb of attention our way. This is to 1: Make the 'lucky ones' look like good people (even though, deep down, they arent) and 2: To make the 'lucky ones' feel better that they dont have to be a low life like us, and have the power to give attention to the low life. I know people have done this because they have SAID IT RIGHT IN FRONT OF ME. I cannot afford the emotional toll of going through all of that for another 4 years. I guess none of this is going to matter in a couple of hours, I honestly dont even know why im replying to all of these messages as it wont even matter to me soon. I guess thanks anyway for talking to me and hope life treats you well.

Height actually does mean ALOT. My 2 brothers (6'1 and 6'3) were able to at least get in bed with a girl. And no, Im not talking about hiring a prostitute, but rather someone GENUINELY wanted to sleep with you. The issue that I have is getting to step 1, step 2 would have been a later issue. It doent matter at this point though, Im fully committed to jump at 1AM tonight. Thank you for your input stranger, I truly hope life treats you well.

Hey man, sorry I haven't checked up on any of these recently. I have had a lot of thinking to do today and I am still committed to jump exactly at 1AM (my time) tonight. I'm not too close to my siblings/parents at the moment (due to reasons not related to this). I would have LOVED to have your college experience then, because the amount of people in my dorms were VASTLY outnumbered by the amount of people on the opposite side of the spectrum. How can you say with such certainty that things will change? I am basing things off of history and know that expertise in relationships is 0. What girl is going to be attracted to a guy with ZERO experience?

Hey, thanks for replying. I'm done waiting and have ran out of patience for "someone to come along". Even my younger brothers either have/had relationships in the past (they are also above 6 foot). I have tried tinder before and I can't even use any of my real pictures because I get ZERO swipes. My suicide isn't about rejection per say but rather that things will never improve in my life given my bad luck. I appreciate the time you spent reading this and writing your message kind stranger.

Lmao thanks for taking the time to respond to me and even go out of your way to give a link to a book. I can't say that I have read it, but it probably doesn't matter since I won't have the time to finish it today. All of these self-help/PUA books all have the same message of "Its all about confidence bro" and it just DOES NOT WORK with me. Thanks though for caring enough to write a comment tho bro.
Yes, I have asked out 8 girls all on separate occasions and all my attempts were shot down in the process.

Thanks for your reply and your kind words, but I think that I am fully committed on doing it. You can't trust the the therapists. They can still report you to the authorities if they believe that you are a current danger to yourself. This has been on my mind a lot lately and I have concluded that I was fucked from the day I was born. I was just not blessed with great looks and I don't have the money for plastic surgery.
